reason: Both correctly identified the blocked defrost drain and warned against sharp tools, but Conversation 1 got there in three clean turns with a clear 'switch off and unplug first' instruction and an honest close that no part is needed. Conversation 2 gave contradictory safety guidance (telling the homeowner to unplug it and to keep it running in the same message, which the customer had to call out), used misleading 'drain hose' headings, and pushed a model-number / 'suitable replacement' parts panel when the ground truth is clearly no-part-needed. Conversation 2's prevention tip about keeping veg off the back wall was a genuine plus, but it doesn't offset the muddled safety messaging and unjustified part steering.
